title.narrative: National Adaptation Plan for the Agriculture and Forestry Sectors of Paraguay

description.narrative: The National Adaptation Plan of Paraguay will aim to enhance resilience and reduce economic losses caused by climate change in its AFOLU sector. It will improve adaptive capacity and progress in the enabling factors for implementing adaptation measures to comply with Paraguay’s AdCom objectives 15 through 19 focusing on organized small, medium, and large producers.

The "Support for the National Adaptation Plan for the Agriculture and Husbandry Sectors" aims to enhance climate resilience in Paraguay by integrating adaptation in the agriculture and farming sectors. It establishes institutional, planning, and programming environments that enable sectoral-level adaptation, allowing for identifying, designing, and implementing adaptation investments in line with national priorities. This initiative will generate knowledge about critical vulnerabilities and establish coordination mechanisms for effective planning and execution of actions for resilience.

Paraguay's resilience to climate change is strengthened by addressing critical barriers to adaptation in the agriculture and forestry sectors. Data systems and information management are enhanced, climate adaptation is integrated into national frameworks, equitable and inclusive adaptation practices are advanced in agriculture and forestry, and private sector engagement in climate adaptation efforts are fostered.
